post.description:
Creates a new author with a unique name.
Only users with the Admin role can access this endpoint.

403.description: User does not have the Admin role.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of authors.
get.description:
Returns active authors ordered by name.
Supports pagination using pageNumber and pageSize.

put.description:
Updates an author's name.
Only users with the Admin role can access this endpoint.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the author to update.

403.description: User does not have the Admin role.

delete.description:
Marks the author as deleted without removing it
permanently from the database.
Authors with active books cannot be deleted.
Only users with the Admin role can access this endpoint.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the author to delete.

403.description: User does not have the Admin role.

post.summary: Creates a new book with a required cover image.
post.description:
Only Admin users can create books.
The request must be multipart/form-data.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of books with optional filters.
get.description:
Supports filtering by author, category and publication year.
Filters can be used individually or combined.
Returns only active books.

put.summary: Updates book details without changing its cover image.
put.description:
Updates title, publication year, author and category.
Only Admin users can perform this operation.

404.description: Book, author or category not found.

get.summary: Retrieves a book by its ID.

delete.description:
Marks the book as deleted without removing it
permanently from the database.
The book cover image is preserved.
Only Admin users can perform this operation.

put.summary: Updates only the cover image of an existing book.
put.description:
Replaces the old cover image with a new image.
The image is required.
Only Admin users can perform this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves all available authors for book filtering.
get.description: Returns all active authors, including those without books.

get.summary: Retrieves all available categories for book filtering.
get.description: Returns all active categories, including those without books.

get.summary: Retrieves available publication years for book filtering.
get.description:
Returns distinct publication years from active books,
ordered from newest to oldest.

post.description:
Creates a category with a unique name.
Only Admin users can perform this operation.

get.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of active categories.
get.description:
Returns categories sorted by name.
Supports pagination with pageNumber and pageSize.

put.description:
Updates the category name.
Only Admin users can perform this operation.

delete.description:
Marks the category as deleted without removing it
permanently from the database.
Categories with active books cannot be deleted.
Only Admin users can perform this operation.
